Custody is clean: subject unmoved at 64eba479... and 0444 at both ends, HEAD steady, 45/45 chain pins reproduce, both frozen v31 verdicts reproduce with no replacement, 38 changed paths with zero off-roster, reviewGuidance a pure append, Linux still in D-002 slice 1, all 28 D-096 mentions refusals. Every predecessor finding is repaired. The blocker that Codex and I reached independently is closed by the route we both named: the fail-closed cell is gone, NT-TCB-DISCLOSE-KEXEC restores the disclosure and strengthens it to cover a kexec 'including one that copies NT_GNU_BUILD_ID', and the datum survives only as buildIdDriftDetector with standing OPTIONAL-NON-CLOSING, notAuthenticity true, and an explicit prohibition on treating a matching build-id as proof that the executing bytes equal the firmware-launched member. authenticatedKernelMember carries the same prohibition, g22 records the limitation rather than asserting closure, and the new kexecHarnessPrecondition is candid that it is a lab precondition and not a proof. Codex's two SHOULD-FIX are closed with explicit governing sentences — one transcript interval covering PCR 0/1/2/4/7 that governs over any narrower remnant, and a GOVERNING recomputation rule that enumerates where byte recomputation is mandatory and where signed digest equality is the intended proof — and the advisory's unpinned specification and index names are resolved. What remains is one sentence. enforcedBootPolicy.runtimeContinuity still ends 'NT-TCB-KEXEC is currentExecution.gnuBuildId, not this field', and neither NT-TCB-KEXEC nor currentExecution exists in this generation: the first was replaced by a disclosure that is expressly not a pass/fail cell, the second by an optional non-closing detector. Three live clauses forbid the reading that sentence invites and one asserts it, with no precedence rule reaching it, in a generation that added exactly such a rule in two other places and recorded that stale sentences in this very field had been removed. Because every operative clause points the other way and nothing now requires the datum, no attestation is falsified and this is a determinacy defect rather than an authenticity hole. Deleting or restating that one sentence closes it.
